title: CWP/21118/2024 of HARI SINGH Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ANR
text:
Sr. No.208 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision : 08.01.2025 Hari Singh …Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and another …Respondents CORAM : HON’BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present : Mr. Narender Kaajla, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr.Sumit Gupta, Additional A.G., Haryana. LAPITA BANERJI, J. (Oral) The present writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing/setting aside of the impugned order dated July 4, 2024 passed by the District Collector, Hisar whereby the petitioner was directed to get the re-registration of arms license in accordance with the instructions received from the Government vide letter No.3/335/2021-2 HG-III dated June 30, 2022.

2. The petitioner was directed to apply through Saral Antodya Portal with complete documents for necessary action in the matter by the State respondents.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the impugned order is arbitrary and illegal and should be set aside.

4. Learned State counsel submits that matter has been examined by the Government and as per Instructions dated November 26, 2024, it has been directed that all the applications/cases relating to Arms License Services received prior to July 01, 2022 should be disposed of on merit and would not be merely cancelled or rejected due to the launch of an online portal. The relevant portion of the Instructions is reproduced hereunder:- “No.3/335/2021-1HG-III From The Additional Chief Secretary to Government, Haryana, Home Department To

1. All the District Magistrates in Haryana.

2. All the Commissioners of Police in Haryana.

3. All the Deputy Commissioners of Police in Haryana.

4. All the Superintendent of Police in Haryana. Dated Chandigarh, the 26. 11.2024 Subject: Start of Online Application of several Arms Licenses related service in the State of Haryana w.e.f. 01.07.2022-Cases/applications pending before 01.07.2022reg. I am directed to refer to the letter dated 30.06.2022 on the subject noted above and to say that the matter regarding the cases/applications relating to arms Licenses Services received prior to 01.07.2022 and pending as on 01.07.2022 i.e. the date when the online application portal was made effective, has been considered by the Government and it has been decided that such cases/applications relating to Arms Licenses Services received prior to 01.07.2022 and pending as on 01.07.2022, if any, shall be decided and disposed off on merits and such cases shall not be rejected/cancelled by a single order mentioning that a system of online portal has been launched w.e.f 01.07.2022.

2. The above instructions be brought to the notice of all the concerned for strict compliance. Any lapse on part of the concerned person shall be viewed seriously and action will be taken against the erring officers/officials in accordance with the Rules. Sd/- Superintendent Home-III, For Additional Chief Secretary to Government, Haryana, Home Department”

5. In the aforesaid circumstances, the District Magistrate, Hisar is directed to consider the application of the petitioner for re-registration of Arms License, in accordance with law.

6. Considering the facts that application for re-registration of the Arms License is pending since October 22, 2020, learned District Magistrate, Hisar is further directed to consider and decide the application for re-registration of the Arms Licence within a period of two months from the date of receiving of a copy of this order.

7. Writ petition is disposed of accordingly. (LAPITA BANERJI) JUDGE January 08, 2025 Vandana
